name: Gyokusendo Shuzo
about: Gyokusendo Shuzo was founded in 1806 in Yoro, Gifu, a town known for its spring water. It brews with the very soft water of the Yoro hills, and its main sake brand is Reisen.

The brewery mills all its rice itself and runs a modern koji room. Besides sake, it makes a three-year aged junmai hon-mirin and whisky, including a single malt that it distils and ages itself. Its whisky licence dates from 1949.
